title: Conormal snake exact sequence for the absolute residue differential comparison
statement: Let $p$ be prime and $A\to B$ a local homomorphism of local commutative $\mathbf F_p$-algebras with compatible scalar structures. Put $K=A/\mathfrak m_A$, $L=B/\mathfrak m_B$, with the induced field map $K\to L$. Let $C=L\otimes_K(\mathfrak m_A/\mathfrak m_A^2)$, $D=\mathfrak m_B/\mathfrak m_B^2$, and let $\beta:L\otimes_A\Omega_{A/\mathbf F_p}\to L\otimes_B\Omega_{B/\mathbf F_p}$ be residueDifferentialComparison [lem-weil-pbc-pth-root-residue-differentials], using [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. There exist an $L$-linear map $\alpha:C\to D$ and five $L$-linear maps making an exact sequence $0\to\ker\alpha\to\ker\beta\to H_1(L_{L/K})\to D/\operatorname{im}\alpha\to (L\otimes_B\Omega_{B/\mathbf F_p})/\operatorname{im}\beta\to\Omega_{L/K}\to0$. Here $H_1$ is the first homology of the naive cotangent complex [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]; endpoint exactness means injection at the left and surjection at the right. No finite-dimensionality or regularity is assumed.

proof.text: For F_p -> A -> K, prime-field H1 vanishing and the two middle Jacobi-Zariski exactness assertions make δ injective. Use the surjective presentation of A -> K and h1CotangentEquivCotangent to identify its domain with the local conormal space. Compose the inverse equivalence with the presentation cotangentComplex; this gives an injective conormal arrow and exactness with mapBaseChange. The same argument applies to B -> L. The maps to the field differentials are surjective.

Tensor the A conormal row with L over K using field flatness. Tensor cancellation gives its middle term L tensor_A Omega[A/F_p]. Define b as the base change of the residue differential quotient composed with inverse cancellation; define a by cancellation after base change of the conormal arrow. On universal differential generators, d beta = gamma b: both send 1 tensor da to d of the image in L. Hence beta a takes values in ker d = range c. Define alpha by factoring beta a through the inverse of the injective map c onto its range. Its left square commutes by the inverse law; connecting-map naturality is not needed.

For F_p -> K -> L, prime-field H1 vanishing and middle Jacobi-Zariski exactness identify H1(L/K) linearly with ker gamma. Right exactness of differentials and the first isomorphism theorem identify coker gamma with Omega[L/K].

Use Mathlib Algebra.Module.SnakeLemma.δ′ and exact_δ′_right/left to construct the connecting map ker gamma -> coker alpha and prove exactness on both sides. Construct the kernel restrictions and the cokernel quotient maps explicitly. Injectivity of the upper conormal arrow proves injection of ker alpha -> ker beta; a lift along the upper exact row proves exactness at ker beta. Lift along the lower exact row to prove exactness at coker beta, and lower-row surjectivity proves surjection onto coker gamma. Transport the middle kernel and terminal cokernel through the two field linear equivalences to obtain the stated sequence.

lean.statement:
theorem residue_conormal_snake_sequence
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (A : Type u) (B : Type v)
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra (ZMod p) A] [Algebra A B]
    [Algebra (ZMod p) B] [IsScalarTower (ZMod p) A B]
    [IsLocalRing A] [IsLocalRing B] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap A B)] :
    let K := IsLocalRing.ResidueField A
    let L := IsLocalRing.ResidueField B
    let β := residueDifferentialComparison p A B
    ∃ (α : (L ⊗[K] IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace A) →ₗ[L] IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace B)
      (f₀ : α.ker →ₗ[L] β.ker)
      (f₁ : β.ker →ₗ[L] H1Cotangent K L)
      (f₂ : H1Cotangent K L →ₗ[L] (IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace B ⧸ α.range))
      (f₃ : (IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace B ⧸ α.range) →ₗ[L]
        ((L ⊗[B] KaehlerDifferential (ZMod p) B) ⧸ β.range))
      (f₄ : ((L ⊗[B] KaehlerDifferential (ZMod p) B) ⧸ β.range) →ₗ[L]
        KaehlerDifferential K L),
      Function.Injective f₀ ∧ Function.Exact f₀ f₁ ∧ Function.Exact f₁ f₂ ∧
        Function.Exact f₂ f₃ ∧ Function.Exact f₃ f₄ ∧ Function.Surjective f₄
